note: Playbook cards for the 12 P1 scam workflows of the RAKSHAM 50-scam catalogue. In production each card is Ed25519-signed by an analyst before it is pushed to devices. Stages are evaluated on metadata only: no message text, no call audio. 'anchor' is the one stage a card cannot complete without, so generic signals (unknown caller + new payee) never complete a severe card on their own.

cards.name: Digital arrest (fake CBI / ED / police on video)
cards.reason: No police or agency arrests anyone on a video call or asks you to move money to 'verify' it.
cards.question: Is someone on a call telling you that you are under investigation?

cards.name: Fake recovery agent / fake cyber police (re-victimisation)
cards.reason: Real police and 1930 never charge a fee to recover your money.
cards.question: Is someone asking for a fee to get back money you lost?

cards.name: Family emergency call (accident / hospital, possibly cloned voice)
cards.reason: Callers who say a family member is in trouble often are not who they claim. Check with the person on their saved number first.
cards.question: Is a caller asking you to pay because someone you know is in trouble?

cards.name: Video call from a 'friend or colleague' asking for money
cards.reason: The person on the video may not be who they look like. Confirm on the number you already have saved.
cards.question: Did a friend just ask you for money over a video call from a new number?

cards.name: Fake 'money credited by mistake' SMS, return it
cards.reason: No money actually arrived in your account. The 'credited' SMS is fake.
cards.question: Are you returning money someone says they sent you by mistake?

cards.name: Deepfake celebrity / FM investment ad
cards.reason: Small 'profits' followed by bigger deposits to new accounts is how investment scams grow.
cards.question: Are you investing after seeing an ad or video of a famous person?

cards.name: Fake IPO / pre-IPO allotment, fake SEBI advisor
cards.reason: SEBI-registered intermediaries collect money only through '@valid' UPI handles. This payee is not one.
cards.question: Is this payment for shares, an IPO or a trading tip?

cards.name: Telegram prepaid task scam (likes / reviews)
cards.reason: Being paid a little first and then asked to 'deposit to unlock' earnings is the task-scam pattern.
cards.question: Are you paying to unlock earnings from an online task?

cards.name: Wedding-invitation / fake APK takeover
cards.reason: An app installed in the last 72 hours can read your SMS or control your screen.
cards.question: Did you install an app from a link or file in the last few days?

cards.name: Screen-share 'KYC / support' (AnyDesk etc.)
cards.reason: Someone may be able to see or control your screen right now. No bank asks you to share your screen.
cards.question: Is someone helping you on a call while sharing your screen?

cards.name: 'Scan this QR to receive money' (inverted QR)
cards.reason: Scanning a QR and entering your PIN always sends money. You never need a PIN to receive.
cards.question: Were you told to scan this QR to receive money?

cards.name: Fake customer care from search / AI chatbot answer
cards.reason: The number you called is not on the company's official list.
cards.question: Did you find this helpline number through a search or chatbot?
